1.1: Me reviit notnin layyadayim, leechad, af lishnayim. machatzit log, lishlosha o learbaa. millog, lachamishsha velaasara ulemea. rabbi yose omer, uvilvad shello yifchot laacharon shebbahem merviit. mosifin al hashsheniyyim veen mosifin al harishonim:
1.2: Bechol hakkelim notnin layyadayim, afillu vichle gelalim, bichle avanim, bichle adama. en notnin layyadayim, lo vedafnot hakkelim, velo veshule hammachatz, velo vimgufat hechavit. velo yitten lachavero vechafnav, mippene sheen memallein veen mekaddeshin veen mazzin me chattat veen notnim layyadayim ella vichli. veen matztzilin betzamid patil ella chelim, sheen matztzilin miyyad keli cheres ella chelim:
1.3: Hammayim shennifselu mishshetiyyat habbehema, bechelim, pesulim. uvekarkaot, kesherim. nafal letochan deyo, komos, vekankantom venishtannu marehen, pesulin. asa vahem melacha o sheshshara vahen pitto, pesulin. shimon hattimni omer, afillu nitkavven lishrot baze venafal lashsheni, kesherim:
1.4: Hediach bahem et hakkelim o shemmicha vahem et hammiddot, pesulim. hediach bahem kelim mudachim o chadashim, kesherim. rabbi yose fosel bachadashim:
1.5: Hammayim shehannachtom matbil bahem et haggeluskin, pesulim. ucheshehu mediach et yadav bahen, kesherim. hakkol kesherim litten layyadayim, afillu cheresh shote vekatan. manniach chavit ben birkav venotel. matte chavit al tziddah venotel. vehakkof notel layyadayim. rabbi yose fosel bishne ellu:

2.1: Natal leyado achat mishshetifa achat, yado tehora. lishte yadav mishshetifa achat, rabbi meir metamme, ad sheyyittol merviit. nafal kikkar shel teruma, tahor. rabbi yose metamme:
2.2: Natal et harishonim lemakom echad, veet hashsheniyyim lemakom acher, venafal kikkar shel teruma al harishonim, tame, veal hashsheniyyim, tahor. natal et harishonim veet hashsheniyyim lemakom echad, venafal kikkar shel teruma, tame. natal et harishonim venimtza al yadav kesam o tzeror, yadav temeot, sheen hammayim haacharonim metaharim ella hammayim sheal gabbe hayyad. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, kol shehu mibberiyyat hammayim, tahor:
2.3: Hayyadayim mittammeot umittaharot ad happerek. ketzad. natal et harishonim ad happerek, veet hashsheniyyim chutz lapperek, vechazru layyad, tehora. natal et harishonim veet hashsheniyyim chutz lapperek vechazru layyad, temea. natal et harishonim leyado achat venimlach venatal et hashsheniyyim lishte yadav, temeot. natal et harishonim lishte yadav venimlach venatal et hashsheniyyim leyado achat, yado tehora. natal leyado achat veshifshefah bachavertah, temea. berosho o vakkotel, tehora. notlin arbaa vachamishsha ze vetzad ze o ze al gabbe ze, uvilvad sheyyerappu sheyyavou vahem hammayim:
2.4: Safek naasa vahem melacha safek lo naasa vahem melacha, safek yesh bahem kashshiur safek sheen bahem kashshiur, safek temeim safek tehorin, sefekan tahor, mippene sheamru, sefek hayyadayim littame uletamme velittaher, tahor. rabbi yose omer, littaher, tame. ketzad. hayu yadav tehorot ulefanav shene chikkarim temeim, safek naga safek lo naga, hayu yadav temeot ulefanav shene chikkarim tehorim, safek naga safek lo naga. hayu yadav achat temea veachat tehora ulefanav shene chikkarim tehorim, naga beachad mehem, safek battemea naga safek battehora naga. hayu yadav tehorot ulefanav shene chikkarim, echad tame veechad tahor, naga beachad mehen, safek battame naga safek battahor naga. hayu yadav achat temea veachat tehora ulefanav shene chikkarim echad tame veechad tahor, naga bishtehen, safek temea vattame utehora vattahor, o tehora vattame utemea vattahor, hayyadayim kemo shehayu vehakkikkarim kemot shehayu:

3.1: Hammachnis yadav levayit hamenugga, yadav techillot, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim, yadav sheniyyot. kol hametamme vegadim bishat maggao, metamme et hayyadayim lihyot techillot, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim, lihyot sheniyyot. amru lo lerabbi akiva, hechan matzinu shehayyadayim techilla vechol makom. amar lahem, vechi heach efshar lahen lihyot techilla ella im ken nitma gufo, chutz mizze. hoochalin vehakkelim shennitmeu vemashkin, metammein et hayyadayim lihyot sheniyyot, divre rabbi yehoshua. vachachamim omrim, et shennitma veav hattuma, metamme et hayyadayim. bivlad hattuma, eno metamme et hayyadayim. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, maase veishsha achat shebbaat lifne abba, amra lo, nichnesu yaday laavir keli cheres. amar lah, bitti, uvamme hayta tumatah, velo shamati ma amra lo. amru chachamim, mevoar haddavar. et shennitma veav hattuma, metamme et hayyadayim. bivlad hattuma, eno metamme et hayyadayim:
3.2: Kol happosel et hatteruma, metamme et hayyadayim lihyot sheniyyot. hayyad metammea et chavertah, divre rabbi yehoshua. vachachamim omrim, en sheni ose sheni. amar lahem, vahalo chitve hakkodesh sheniyyim metammein et hayyadayim. amru lo, en danin divre tora middivre sofrim, velo divre sofrim middivre tora, velo divre sofrim middivre sofrim:
3.3: Retzuot tefillin im hattefillin, metammeot et hayyadayim. rabbi shimon omer, retzuot tefillin enan metammeot et hayyadayim:
3.4: Gillayon shebbassefer, shemmillemalan veshemmillemattan shebbattechilla veshebbassof, metammein et hayyadayim. rabbi yehuda omer, shebbassof eno metamme, ad sheyyaase lo ammud:
3.5: Sefer shennimchak venishtayyer bo shemonim vechamesh otiyyot, kefarashat vayhi binsoa haaron, metamme et hayyadayim. megilla shekkatuv bah shemonim vechamesh otiyyot kefarashat vayhi binsoa haaron, metamma et hayyadayim. kol kitve hakkodesh metammein et hayyadayim. shir hashshirim vekohelet metammein et hayyadayim. rabbi yehuda omer, shir hashshirim metamme et hayyadayim, vekohelet machaloket. rabbi yose omer, kohelet eno metamme et hayyadayim veshir hashshirim machaloket. rabbi shimon omer, kohelet mikkulle vet shammay umechumre vet hillel. amar rabbi shimon ben azzay, mekubbal ani mippi shivim ushenayim zaken, bayyom shehoshivu et rabbi elazar ben azarya bayshiva, sheshshir hashshirim vekohelet metammeim et hayyadayim. amar rabbi akiva, chas veshalom, lo nechelak adam miyyisrael al shir hashshirim shello tetamme et hayyadayim, sheen kol haolam kullo cheday kayyom shennittan bo shir hashshirim leyisrael, shekkol hakketuvim kodesh, veshir hashshirim kodesh kadashim. veim nechleku, lo nechleku ella al kohelet. amar rabbi yochanan ben yehoshua ben chamiv shel rabbi akiva, kedivre ven azzay, kach nechleku vechach gamru:

4.1: Bo vayyom nimnu vegamru al arevat haraglayim, shehi mishshene luggin vead tisha kabbin shennisdeka, shehi temea midras. sherabbi akiva omer, arevat haraglayim kishmah:
4.2: Bo vayyom amru, kol hazzevachim shennizbechu shello lishman, kesherim, ella shello alu labbealim leshum chova, chutz min happesach umin hachattat. happesach bizmanno, vehachattat bechol zeman. rabbi eliezer omer, af haasham. happesach bizmanno, vehachattat vehaasham bechol zeman. amar rabbi shimon ben azzay, mekubbelani mippi shivim ushenayim zaken, bayyom shehoshivu et rabbi elazar ben azarya bayshiva, shekkol hazzevachim hanneechalin shennizbechu shello lishman, kesherim, ella shello alu labbealim leshem chova, chutz min happesach umin hachattat. lo hosif ben azzay ella haola, velo hodu lo chachamim:
4.3: Bo vayyom amru, ammon umoav, ma hen bashsheviit. gazar rabbi tarfon, masar ani. vegazar rabbi elazar ben azarya, maaser sheni. amar rabbi yishmael, elazar ben azarya, alecha reaya lelammed, sheatta machmir, shekkol hammachmir, alav reaya lelammed. amar lo rabbi elazar ben azarya, yishmael achi, ani lo shinniti misseder hashshanim, tarfon achi shinna, vealav reaya lelammed. heshiv rabbi tarfon, mitzrayim chutz laaretz, ammon umoav chutz laaretz, ma mitzrayim masar ani vashsheviit, af ammon umoav masar ani vashsheviit. heshiv rabbi elazar ben azarya, bavel chutz laaretz, ammon umoav chutz laaretz, ma bavel maaser sheni vashsheviit, af ammon umoav maaser sheni vashsheviit. amar rabbi tarfon, mitzrayim shehi kerova, asauha masar ani, sheyyihyu aniyye yisrael nismachim aleha bashsheviit, af ammon umoav, shehem kerovim, naasim masar ani, sheyyihyu aniyye yisrael nismachim alehem bashsheviit. amar lo rabbi elazar ben azarya, hare atta chimhannan mamon, veen atta ella chemafsid nefashot. kovea atta et hashshamayim millehorid tal umatar, shenneemar (Malachi 3), hayikba adam elohim ki attem kovim oti vaamartem bamme kevaanucha hammaaser vehatteruma. amar rabbi yehoshua, hareni chemeshiv al tarfon achi, aval lo leinyan devarav. mitzrayim maase chadash, uvavel maase yashan, vehanniddon shellefanenu maase chadash. yiddon maase chadash mimmaase chadash, veal yiddon maase chadash mimmaase yashan. mitzrayim maase zekenim, uvavel maase neviim, vehanniddon shellefanenu maase zekenim. yiddon maase zekenim mimmaase zekenim, veal yiddon maase zekenim mimmaase neviim. nimnu vegamru, ammon umoav measserin masar ani bashsheviit. ucheshebba rabbi yose ben durmaskit etzel rabbi eliezer belod, amar lo, ma chiddush haya lachem bevet hammidrash hayyom. amar lo, nimnu vegamru, ammon umoav measserim masar ani bashsheviit. bacha rabbi eliezer veamar, sod Adonai lireav uverito lehodiam (tehillim ko). tze veemor lahem, al tachoshshu leminyanchem. mekubbal ani merabban yochanan ben zakkay, sheshshama merabbo, verabbo merabbo ad halacha lemoshe missinay, sheammon umoav measserin masar ani bashsheviit:
4.4: Bo vayyom ba yehuda, ger ammoni, veamad lifnehen bevet hammidrash. amar lahem, ma ani lavo vakkahal. amar lo rabban gamliel, asur atta. amar lo rabbi yehoshua, muttar atta. amar lo rabban gamliel, hakkatuv omer (Devarim 23), lo yavo ammoni umoavi bikhal Adonai gam dor asiri vegomer. amar lo rabbi yehoshua, vechi ammonim umoavim bimkoman hen. kevar ala sancheriv melech ashshur uvilbel et kol haummot, shenneemar (yeshaya 10), veasir gevulot ammim vaatudotehem shoseti veorid kabbir yoshvim. amar lo rabban gamliel, hakkatuv omer (yirmeya mat), veachare chen ashiv et shevut bene ammon, uchevar chazru. amar lo rabbi yehoshua, hakkatuv omer (yirmeya 30 3), veshavti et shevut ammi yisrael vihuda, vaadayin lo shavu. hittiruhu lavo vakkahal:
4.5: Targum shebbeezra veshebbedaniyyel, metamme et hayyadayim. targum shekketavo ivrit veivrit shekketavo targum, uchetav ivri, eno metamme et hayyadayim. leolam eno metamme, ad sheyyichtevennu ashshurit, al haor, uvidyo:
4.6: Omrim tzedokim, kovlin anu alechem, perushim, sheattem omrim, kitve hakkodesh metammein et hayyadayim, vesifre homeris eno metamme et hayyadayim. amar rabban yochanan ben zakkay, vechi en lanu al happerushim ella zo vilvad. hare hem omrim, atzmot chamor tehorim veatzmot yochanan kohen gadol temeim. amru lo, lefi chibbatan hi tumatan, shello yaase adam atzmot aviv veimmo tarvadot. amar lahem, af kitve hakkodesh lefi chibbatan hi tumatan, vesifre homeris, sheenan chavivin, enan metammein et hayyadayim:
4.7: Omrim tzedokin, kovlin anu alechem, perushim, sheattem metaharim et hannitztzok. omrim happerushim, kovlin anu alechem, tzedokim, sheattem metaharim et ammat hammayim habbaa mibbet hakkevarot. omrim tzedokin, kovlin anu alechem, perushim, sheattem omrim, shori vachamori shehizziku, chayyavin. veavdi vaamati shehizziku, peturin. ma im shori vachamori, sheeni chayyav bahem mitzvot, hare ani chayyav benizkan. avdi vaamati, sheani chayyav bahen mitzvot, eno din sheehe chayyav benizkan. amru lahem, lo. im amartem beshori vachamori, sheen bahem daat, tomru beavdi uvaamati, sheyyesh bahem daat. sheim aknitem, yelech veyadlik gedisho shel acher veehe chayyav leshallem:
4.8: Amar tzedoki gelili, kovel ani alechem, perushim, sheattem kotvin et hammoshel im moshe bagget. omrim perushim, kovlin anu alecha, tzedoki gelili, sheattem kotvim et hammoshel im hashshem baddaf, velo od, ella sheattem kotvin et hammoshel milmalan veet hashshem millemattan, shenneemar (Shemot 5) vayyomer paro mi Adonai asher eshma bekolo leshallach et yisrael. ucheshellaka mahu omer (sham 9), Adonai hatztzaddik:
